subject: Endcap demo gallery + branded pillars — layout signoff & collateral counts
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: convert endcap to demo gallery + three branded pillars (layout attached)

Team —

Attached is my draft of the endcap rework for booth 4C-22. Instead of a traditional inline counter we propose a short "demo gallery": three 6' reclaimed-pallet display stacks (low profile) and three vertical branded pillars to increase sightlines from the concourse. The goal is to make the demo flow visible from the aisle while keeping demo noise contained.

Key asks:
- Can Facilities confirm we can place 3 pillars (max base 24" dia) and that the carpet patch for the pallets is acceptable?
- Karthik: is there any power rework required if we move the demo carts ~6' from the current floorplan?
- Tessa/Marissa: please review collateral counts below and flag any shortages.

Deadline: I need a vendor quote and signoff to order prints by EOD Friday (2028-04-14) to meet a 3-week print/ship lead time.

Attachments: floorplan_v2.pdf (sketch + measurements)

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: floorplan_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: ShowFloor Exhibits <exhibits@showfloor.co>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@showfloor.co>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal: convert endcap to demo gallery + three branded pillars (layout attached)

Hi Camila / team —

Thanks for the sketch. We ran the attached layout through our production and permit checklist. Quick summary:
- Pillars: 3x custom printed 7' vertical foam-core-wrapped columns (aluminum core), base footprint 22" dia each. We recommend 7' (rather than 6') to improve visibility from the concourse; if you prefer 6' we can do that but the print area will shrink.
- Pallets: reclaimed-look display pallets with laminate top and grommeted cable ports for a single 110V drop each. Weight per pallet fully loaded: ~95 lbs.
- Power: we need 3 additional floor pockets (one per pallet). If you can confirm the exhibitor's existing 20A feed location we can place pockets and run neat cable covers.
- Permits: no special rigging permits required for the columns but the venue requires a flame-retardant cert for the pallet tops (we'll supply).

Lead times and cost (attached): showfloor_quote_0409.pdf. If you sign off by 2028-04-14 we can guarantee production and arrival for exhibitor move-in.

We quoted two options: standard print (matte) and premium UV laminate (scratch resistant). See quote pages 2-3 for line-item pricing.

Let us know which pillar height and finish you want and confirm power pocket placement.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Project Manager | ShowFloor Exhibits
elena@showfloor.co | (312) 555-4022
[Attachment: showfloor_quote_0409.pdf (PDF, 680KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert endcap to demo gallery + three branded pillars (layout attached)

Camila —

I reviewed the vendor notes. A few quick technical items:
- Power: current 20A feed sits at the back left corner of 4C-22. Running three floor pockets is fine but we should keep each demo cart to a single low-draw power strip (we don't want parallel high-watt heaters or chargers). I'll confirm final routing with Venue Ops today.
- Sightlines: Elena's guidance to bump pillars to 7' makes sense for visibility but we need to ensure the pillars don't obstruct the demo camera angles (Acme's live capture). If we go 7' we should move pillar B slightly toward the center by 8".

Lauren — on collateral: what's the current print manifest? I recall we had lower quantities allocated for the endcap vs. island booths.

Karthik
Sr. Events Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert endcap to demo gallery + three branded pillars (layout attached)

Quick collateral update —
- Pocket guides: 500 printed (we have 380 in the office + 120 on reorder arriving 4/21).
- One-pagers (product brief): 300 printed available. Recommend we order an extra 400 to support passersby at the demo gallery.
- Stickers / swag: current kit contains 200 sticker packs and 150 small swag items. If we want to have grab-and-go by each pallet, order +250 sticker packs.

I've put a provisional manifest in Drive: https://docs.redwood.com/drive/marketing/collateral-manifest (tab "4C-22 endcap").

Marissa — can you place printing for: 700 one-pagers (premium stock), 750 pocket guides (match existing fold), and 300 extra sticker packs? We should set "rush" to standard 3-week turnaround.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Events Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: collateral_manifest_v1.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: ShowFloor Exhibits <exhibits@showfloor.co>, Elena Morales <elena@showfloor.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@acme-apps.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: APPROVED: final layout and collateral order + next steps

Elena / team —

This is approval to proceed with the following choices: pillars at 7' height with premium UV laminate for durability; pallets with the flame-retardant top (agree to vendor cert); and power pockets as proposed.

Marissa: please issue the print order (see Lauren's manifest) and cc ShowFloor on the artwork handoff. Tessa: confirm print dimensions for the pillar wraps (we will use the template from ShowFloor_quote_0409).

Alex (Acme) — looping you in so you can confirm any camera placement constraints on move-in day (we flagged potential 8" shift for pillar B).

Attachments: signed-layout-approval.pdf (signed by me for production)

Elena: please confirm receipt and final production window. We need ETA for delivery to the advance warehouse and move-in day estimate.

Thanks all —
Camila Reyes
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
